title: multiplate-v1 region result row
description: One JSONL row of results/predictions_{arm}.jsonl: per-image region-level predictions from one benchmark arm. The arm is carried by the file name (detector, proposals, or oracle-crops), not by a row field. Box coordinates (box, and gt_box on the oracle arm) are fractions of image width/height in [0, 1]. The oracle-crops arm additionally carries gt_label and gt_box (the ground-truth class and box of each crop); the detector arm additionally carries coco_label (the raw COCO class before mapping to the eval taxonomy). The optional provenance field, when present, must use the production ScanProvenance raw values from apps/ios/Capability/Core/Recognition/ScanContracts.swift — the benchmark feed is a first-class ScanInputSource (case benchmark), so result rows stay name-compatible with production scan provenance.

provenance.description: Optional production-aligned provenance tag; values must equal the ScanProvenance enum cases in ScanContracts.swift.

label.description: Predicted eval-taxonomy class name (one of the manifest's 29 classes).

coco_label.description: Raw COCO class name before mapping (detector arm only).

gt_label.description: Ground-truth class of the crop (oracle-crops arm only).

gt_box.description: Ground-truth box of the crop, normalized (oracle-crops arm only). Bounds allow a 0.01 numerical tolerance: detector boxes are not clamped and may fall epsilon outside [0, 1].

box.description: Predicted box, normalized to image width/height. Bounds allow a 0.01 numerical tolerance: detector outputs are not clamped and may fall epsilon outside [0, 1].
